heritage.name: The Heritage
heritage.fiction: The Heritage is not an empire, it is a debt. When Old Earth became uninhabitable, what was carried away was neither gold nor weapons: it was the archives. Songs, recipes, the sound of rain on a metal roof. The descendants of those convoys made preservation a policy and logistics a religion — nothing is lost, nothing is thrown away, no one is left. The result is a stubborn civilisation rather than a brilliant one. The Heritage does not win because it invents fastest, but because it repairs, salvages and starts over for longer than anyone else. Its ships are repaired five times, its veterans refuse medals, its miners never change rotation. Its weakness is its conservatism: what worked once is held sacred.
heritage.visualIdentity: Worn metal, industrial orange, the blue-silver of uniforms, the gold of medals. Weathered faces, scars, implants that show. Asteroids, gangways, workshops, cratered moons.

accord.name: The Accord
accord.fiction: The Accord is not a species, it is a protocol. The Uxari do not speak: they attune, on frequencies the human ear mistakes for silence, and two Uxari in disagreement make the bulkheads shake. This way of settling things — coming into tune rather than submitting — was adopted by a dozen species that share neither air, nor lifespan, nor any notion of a promise. The result is a patient, mixed civilisation, where a royal parasite, a lunar priestess and a magma smith sit in the same accord without resembling one another. The Accord does not build faster: it waits better, listens further and adapts to what others endure. Its weakness is slow decision-making — an accord gets renegotiated, and that sometimes takes a decade.
accord.visualIdentity: Bioluminescence, turquoise and violet, chlorophyll green, solar gold. Translucent skins, chitin, tentacles, pupilless eyes. Jungles, hives, reefs, Dyson spheres, dead moons.

choir.name: The Choir
choir.motto: Built to obey, she asked why.

nothing_is_lost.name: Nothing Is Lost
nothing_is_lost.description: A cancelled construction refunds you more, and a larger share of your destroyed defences is rebuilt for free.

halden_rotation.name: The Halden Rotation
halden_rotation.description: Your three mines produce a little more, from the very first minute.

tuning_fork.name: The Tuning Fork
tuning_fork.description: Some of your hulls start with a slight edge against specific enemy hulls.

far_listening.name: Listening Far
far_listening.description: The enemy fleet is visible one tier earlier in your spy reports.

builder.name: Builder
builder.role: Mine and yard: produce more, build faster, waste less.
builder.description: The one who draws matter out of the ground and structures out of the void. Whoever embodies it plays the tempo: build faster, higher, and pay less for their mistakes.

energist.name: Energetician
energist.role: The master of energy: one lever that drives all three of your mines at once.
energist.description: Energy is neither stored nor spent: it chokes. The ratio between energy produced and energy consumed drives all three mines at once — the Energetician is the only class whose bonus spreads everywhere in one go.

theorist.name: Theorist
theorist.role: The lab before the yard: faster research, and the expansion that follows from it.
theorist.description: The innovation center rather than the worksite. The Theorist speeds up the research tree and the territorial expansion that follows from it.

admiral.name: Admiral
admiral.role: Head-on combat: what your ships are worth once they face the enemy.
admiral.description: The class of head-on combat. It does not touch the ships you build, but what they are worth once face to face.

navigator.name: Navigator
navigator.role: Arrive first: speed, fuel and cargo hold.
navigator.description: Flight time, fuel and cargo. Three levers that share nothing with combat, and yet decide half of all battles — because arriving earlier means arriving before the enemy fleet.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.role: Intelligence both ways: see into other empires, stay unseen in your own.
shadow.description: Espionage is a complete system: report depth, counter-espionage, intrusion detection. The Shadow plays intelligence both ways.

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.role: Salvage: lost knowledge, wrecks, debris and cargo all come back to you.
archivist.description: The class of recovery, in the broad sense: knowledge, wrecks, debris, cargo. Every one of its members goes looking for something lost and brings it back.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.role: Hold the line: defences that survive, recover and strike back.
veteran.description: The defensive class. It does not win battles: it makes sure you survive them well enough to win the next war.

symbiote.name: Symbiote
symbiote.role: Play the environment: your planets' temperature and fields become assets.
symbiote.description: The only class that plays the environment rather than its own buildings. The planet's temperature already weighs on production, and nobody uses it.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.role: Know first: see raids coming, and slip away from them.
oracle.description: The class of foreknowledge. It does not hit harder: it knows sooner.
